## Failure pattern

What specific task or behavior would this improve?

## Proposed change

Which current instruction is insufficient? Suggest concise wording or an example.

## Evidence and tradeoffs

Include a reproducible case if possible. Could this add overhead, contradict
other instructions, or trigger on trivial tasks?

## Validation

How would you tell whether it helped? State what has actually been tried.
